spots.bio: Small uninhabited island where Cast Away was filmed, with white sand beaches and a pine forest, reached by boat.
spots.notes: Wikivoyage: uninhabited, very much off the beaten track, Cast Away shot there. Wikipedia: part of the Mamanucas group, off Viti Levu. 'White beaches and pine forest' came from the draft bio and was not re-confirmed in sources read. No operator price sourced (multi-island cruises only), so cost left empty. Cost: about 160 per adult for the Hidden Gem Fiji half-day Monuriki and Mana Sandbar trip (4 hrs, via reseller Bookme; currency not stated on listing, assumed FJD as other Bookme Fiji listings). Full-day operator cruises (South Sea Cruises Adult FJD 224) not confirmed to stop at Monuriki. Reseller only; unverified.
